text:
2022 FIFA Wiase Kɔpu a wɔyɛe wɔ Qatar fi 20 November kɔsi 18 December no, na ɛyɛ adikan a wɔyɛe wɔ Arab man ne Middle East, na ɛyɛ adikan a wɔbɔɔ wɔ November ne December mu sen May-July daa, a wɔyɛe sɛnea wɔbɛtumi agye Qatar nkyini mu hyew. Ɛyɛ nso adikan a ɛwɔ 32 kuw ansa na wɔde kɔ 48 wɔ 2026. Nnipa 32 no wɔde yɛɛ kuw awotwe a ɛwɔ anan anan, wɔbɔɔ round-robin ansa na wɔde knockout phase a ɛwɔ round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off, ne final. Kupɔ no yɛ record ma n'akyi a wɔbɔɔ wɔ 32-team format mu, ɛna kuw biara a ɛwɔ mu bɔɔ goal baako pɛ, na wɔkɔɔ nnipa a wɔbaa hɔ 3,404,252 wɔ competition no mu, average 53,191 per match.

Kupɔ mu no yɛɛ upset kɛseɛ bi a Saudi Arabia dii Argentina a ɛdi akyire no so 2-1. Argentina san fii ɔhaw a ɛdi kan no mu kɔɔ anim, ɛna Morocco nso twerɛɛ ne din wɔ abakɔsɛm mu, dii Spain ne Portugal so na ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrika man a edi kan kɔɔ Wiase Kɔpu semi-final, na ɔwiee wɔ muni a ɛto so anan. Croatia gyeɛ muni a ɛto so mmiɛnsa.

Final a wɔbɔɔ wɔ Lusail Stadium wɔ Lusail no de Argentina ne France hyiaa wɔ agorɔ a ɛyɛ nwonwa. Lionel Messi bɔɔ penalty wɔ sima 23 ne Angel Di Maria bɔɔ nea ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ sima 36, ansa na Kylian Mbappe bɔɔ mmienu wɔ ntaban mu, penalty wɔ sima 80 ne goal foforɔ wɔ sima 81, de kɔɔ extra time wɔ 2-2. Messi san de Argentina kɔɔ anim wɔ sima 108, nanso Mbappe wiee ne hat-trick wɔ penalty wɔ sima 118, de yɛɛ 3-3. Argentina dii 4-2 wɔ penalties. Mbappe bɛyɛɛ ɔbarima a ɛto so mmienu a ɔbɔɔ hat-trick wɔ Wiase Kɔpu final akyi Geoff Hurst wɔ 1966, nanso ɔwiee wɔ nkunimdie akyi, na ɔsan gyeɛ Golden Boot sɛ ɔbɔɔ goals 8. Messi gyeɛ Golden Ball, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a edi kan a ɔgyee abasobɔ no mmienu akyi 2014, na ɔmaa Argentina ne title a ɛto so mmiɛnsa, akyi 1978 ne 1986.
